notes: POC summary: hosted API performed well for low-latency channel (support chat). devs saw p95 ~ 140ms on short prompts during trial (best-effort region: us-west).

Token distribution (observed): ~62% short (<50 tokens, avg 38), ~28% mid (50-300 tokens, avg 160), ~10% long (>300 tokens, avg 600). Important for cost forecasting.
Client requirement: p95 latency <150ms for chat route; throughput target for production: 120 QPS steady, 400 QPS peak. Will require dedicated pool sizing.

SE Marcus recommendation (rough): dedicated pool equivalent to 6 x A10/RTX8000-class GPUs (or 2 x H100-80GB w/ model sharding) to meet concurrency and latency at 120 QPS steady + caching. Ask: confirm preferred hardware + burst plan.
Cache & batching: expected KV/prefix cache hit ~12-18% based on prompt reuse; batching strategy could reduce token cost by ~15% per token.
Cost sensitivity: product leadership favors predictable committed pricing over variable billed hosted rates. Procurement pushing for 12- or 24-month commit to get 25-35% discount bands.
Security: require SSO (SAML), audit logging retention 13 months, customer-managed KMS. Data residency preference: US only for now.
Quote request: Celerity asked for tiered pricing showing list price, 12mo commit, 24mo commit, and enterprise SLA. SE attached draft pricing deck (drive link).
